def longest_repeated_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    lcs = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        seen = set()
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            substring = s[i:j]
            if substring in seen:
                lcs = max(lcs, j - i)
            seen.add(substring)
    
    return lcs
